name: AWS read-only drift detection and correction proposal

data.label: Platform operator
data.description: Existing operator. Starts analysis runs and reviews the results. Outside the provisioning scope.

data.label: Synthetic inventory snapshots
data.description: Private, versioned bucket that holds the synthetic inventory and desired-state baselines. The workflow can only read it.

data.label: Analysis workflow
data.description: Runs the steps in order: snapshot, checks, plan, diff, then waits for approval. There is no apply step. Its execution role is read-only.

data.label: Policy and drift checks
data.description: Compares the inventory with the baseline and policy rules, then outputs findings. Design-only, so the code still needs to be written.

data.label: Correction plan drafter
data.description: Turns findings into a proposed correction and a reviewable diff. Its plans can't include deletes or permission increases, and it never applies anything. Design-only.

data.label: Foundation model
data.description: Drafts the plan text. The model ID, access and region are not yet chosen or verified. Local tests use scripted responses.

data.label: Plans, diffs and approvals
data.description: Stores findings, proposed diffs and approval decisions for each run. Design-only.

data.label: API audit trail
data.description: Records API activity so we can confirm that only read operations happened.

brief.application: Use AWS for this synthetic architecture qualification. Analyze a synthetic cloud inventory and propose an infrastructure correction. Include read-only inventory, policy checks, plan generation, a reviewable diff and approval/audit controls. Detect drift. Never apply, delete resources or request broader credentials automatically. Draw the complete end-to-end architecture with concrete service choices and connected flows. Explain the first local test, distinguish mocked model behavior from actual model validation, and ask one useful missing-decision question. Do not reduce this application to storage to satisfy generator coverage. Do not invent successful deployment or approved region/account access.

decisions.subject: design.first-aws-sketch-read-only-drift-detection-and-correction-proposal
decisions.title: First AWS sketch: read-only drift detection and correction proposal
decisions.context: Scope: synthetic inventory snapshot, then policy and drift checks, then plan drafting with Bedrock, then a reviewable diff, then human approval, with an audit trail. Assumptions: there is no path to apply or delete, and credentials are never broadened automatically. Region, account, model ID and policy baseline are still undecided. These services are design-only because no native generator exists for them yet. Local tests use scripted model replies.
decisions.decision: Drawn while talking as design revision 2.
